paragraphs: Nezira bar Nezira, Midrash Shemuel 19; Bereshit Rabbah 12 and end of 82: R. Levi in R. Nezira's name. But in section 11, in the same matter as section 12, the reading is Zeira. Yalkut on Psalms, at the beginning of Psalm 92, has Nezira twice.
